findings.title: Tool `search` has unclear description (score 2/5)
findings.description: The description and parameter docs are written in Chinese, which limits accessibility for agents/users operating in other languages. While the schema itself is structurally clear (query, max_results, region with examples), the top-level description is extremely terse ('Search on DuckDuckGo and return formatted results') and omits key information: what 'formatted results' means (fields returned, structure), when to use this vs. other search tools, rate limits or constraints, valid region code format/list, and behavior when no results are found. The generic name 'search' also risks collision with other search tools without disambiguation.

specific_issues: Description and parameter descriptions are in Chinese only — not localized for an English-language agent context
Tool name 'search' is generic; doesn't signal it's DuckDuckGo-specific without reading the description
No description of the result format/shape (what fields come back per result)
No 'when to use' guidance vs. other web search tools (e.g., WebSearch, WebFetch)
No mention of constraints: rate limits, max value for max_results, safe-search behavior, freshness
Region parameter gives a few examples but no link/reference to the full list of valid codes
No mention of error behavior (empty results, network failure, blocked queries)

findings.remediation: Rewrite description to clearly explain what the tool does, when to use it, and key constraints.

findings.title: Tool `fetch_content` has unclear description (score 2/5)
findings.description: The description is written in Chinese ('Fetch and parse web page content from URL') and is extremely brief. While the basic function is conveyable, it lacks crucial information: when to use it vs alternatives, what format the parsed content returns in (HTML stripped? Markdown? plain text?), what happens on failure, whether JavaScript is rendered, authentication support, or rate limits. The parameter descriptions are also in Chinese, which may cause issues for English-operating agents. The max_length default of 8000 is documented but units (characters) are only clear from the Chinese description.

specific_issues: Description written in Chinese without English translation, reducing accessibility for many agents
No indication of when to use this tool vs other web-fetching tools
Output format unspecified (HTML/Markdown/plain text?)
No mention of JavaScript rendering, authentication, or redirect handling
No error behavior documented (timeouts, 404s, blocked content)
Parameter descriptions also in Chinese only
No examples of valid URL formats or constraints

findings.remediation: Rewrite description to clearly explain what the tool does, when to use it, and key constraints.
